# datasintef_datahub (Resource)

Manages a DataSintef datahub. A datahub is a top-level container that owns service instances (Grafana, MinIO, etc.), data products, and permissions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datasintef_datahub" "example" {
  alias       = "my-research-hub"
  name        = "My Research Hub"
  description = "Datahub for the ACME research project."
  project_id  = "12345"

  # Optional: URL to the data management plan. Changing this forces replacement.
  data_management_plan = "https://example.com/dmp/acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Unique alias of the datahub. Used in URLs and as the datahub identifier. Must not contain spaces. Changing this forces a new datahub to be created.
- `description` (String) Description of the datahub.
- `name` (String) Display name of the datahub.
- `project_id` (String) Maconomy research project ID associated with the datahub.

### Optional

- `data_management_plan` (String) URL of the data management plan. Optional. Changing this forces a new datahub to be created (the API has no update endpoint for this field).
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the datahub was created.
- `creator_user_account` (String) User account of the datahub's creator.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the datahub (equal to `alias`).
- `last_editor_user_account` (String) User account of the last editor of the datahub.
- `last_modified` (String) Timestamp when the datahub was last modified.
- `organization_hub` (Boolean) Whether the datahub is an organizational hub.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Timeout for creating a datahub. Defaults to 2m.
- `update` (String) Timeout for updating a datahub. Defaults to 1m.
